# اِنْثَلْتَ (inṯalta) /in.θal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْثَالَ (inṯāla)
# اِنْثَلْتِ (inṯalti) /in.θal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْثَالَ (inṯāla)
